question: Where was the National Cadets Judo Championships 2024-25 held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The National Cadets Judo Championships 2024-25 were held in **Maharashtra**, which is known for hosting numerous national and international sports events.
 
• Maharashtra is a prominent state in India with well-developed sports infrastructure, including facilities for judo and other martial arts.
 
• The event brought together young judo talents from across the country to compete and showcase their skills.
 
• Such events are aimed at identifying and nurturing talent for international competitions like the Olympics and Asian Games.
 
• Judo, as a sport, is being actively promoted in India with initiatives by the Judo Federation of India and support from the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Judo:**

 
 
• Judo is a modern martial art, combat, and Olympic sport that originated in Japan in 1882, founded by Jigoro Kano.
 
• It emphasizes techniques of throwing, pinning, and submission rather than striking or kicking.
 
• Judo is recognized globally and is part of the Summer Olympics since 1964.
 
 
 
• **Judo Federation of India (JFI):**
 
 
• JFI is the apex body for managing and promoting judo in India.
 
• It organizes national-level championships and selects athletes for international competitions.
 
 
 
• **Sports Infrastructure in Maharashtra:**
 
 
• Maharashtra has several state-of-the-art sports facilities, including the Balewadi Sports Complex in Pune and the DY Patil Stadium in Navi Mumbai.
 
• It has hosted multiple national and international tournaments across various sports.
 
 
 
• **Government Initiatives:**
 
 
• The Government of India and states like Maharashtra have launched programs to promote sports and physical fitness, such as Khelo India and Fit India Movement.
 
• These initiatives aim to improve sports facilities and encourage youth participation in sports.
 
 
 
• **Importance of National Championships:**
 
 
• National championships serve as a platform for young athletes to gain experience and exposure.
 
• They play a critical role in talent identification and preparation for international events.
